Calculate weighted (least-cost) distance to target features

Source: R/calc_weighted_distance.R
calc_weighted_distance.Rd

Computes accumulated least-cost distance from target features across a friction (cost) surface using terra::costDist().

Usage

calc_weighted_distance(target, friction, origin_value = -999, ...)

Arguments

target

A SpatVector representing target locations (points, lines, or polygons).

friction

A SpatRaster representing the cost surface. Values must be positive numeric costs.

origin_value

Numeric value used internally to mark origin cells. Default is -999. Must not already exist in the friction raster.

...

additional arguments passed to terra::costDist

Value

A SpatRaster of accumulated least-cost distances.

See also

costDist

Examples

friction <- terra::rast(nrows = 20, ncols = 20, xmin = 0, xmax = 20,
                        ymin = 0, ymax = 20, crs = "EPSG:32636")
terra::values(friction) <- 1
target <- terra::vect(matrix(c(10.5, 10.5), ncol = 2), crs = "EPSG:32636")

calc_weighted_distance(target, friction)
#> class       : SpatRaster
#> size        : 20, 20, 1  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
#> resolution  : 1, 1  (x, y)
#> extent      : 0, 20, 0, 20  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
#> coord. ref. : WGS 84 / UTM zone 36N (EPSG:32636)
#> source(s)   : memory
#> name        :      last

#> max value   : 13.435029
